rules.name: Settlement Accuracy Requirement
rules.statement: A financial settlement record must include item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and net settlement amounts to be considered complete.
rules.condition: when a delivery transaction is finalized for payout
rules.if_violated: The settlement is rejected and the payout process is halted until discrepancies are resolved
rules.rationale: Ensures accurate compensation and prevents financial disputes between the platform and workers

parameters.name: required_settlement_components
parameters.description: List of mandatory financial fields including costs, fees, taxes, commissions, and net amounts

rules.name: Delivery Verification Mandate
rules.statement: A financial transaction record must be linked to verifiable evidence of delivery before finalizing the settlement status.
rules.condition: when an order is marked as delivered for payment processing
exceptions: Force majeure events documented by the Delivery Partner
rules.if_violated: The settlement status remains 'Pending' and funds are withheld until valid proof is uploaded
rules.rationale: Prevents payment for undelivered goods and ensures integrity of the gig-economy logistics model

parameters.name: acceptable_evidence_types
parameters.description: Types of proof accepted such as GPS coordinates, photo timestamps, or signature logs

rules.name: Historical Earnings Transparency
rules.statement: A Delivery Partner may only view their historical earnings summary if the data is derived from finalized settlement records.
rules.condition: when a Delivery Partner accesses the financial transparency portal
rules.if_violated: Access to the earnings view is denied to prevent unauthorized data manipulation or premature viewing
rules.rationale: Ensures workers see only accurate, finalized financial data to maintain trust and compliance

parameters.name: data_finalization_threshold
parameters.description: The state a transaction must reach (e.g., 'Settled') before earnings data is visible

rules.name: Payout Schedule Adherence
rules.statement: A payout schedule must be generated based on the contractual agreement version active at the time of the transaction.
rules.condition: when calculating the amount due for a specific delivery batch
rules.if_violated: The payout calculation is invalidated and the batch is re-queued for recalculation using the correct contract version
rules.rationale: Ensures financial compliance with the specific commission rates and terms agreed upon at the time of service

parameters.name: active_agreement_version
parameters.description: The specific version of the agreement valid for the transaction date
